description: Recorded LLM output for offline fallback. Draft tenant first-notice message for Harbourfront One L23 chilled-water leak affecting Straits Meridian Bank L22.

drafts.subject: Water Leak Investigation — Harbourfront One Level 22/23 — First Notice
drafts.body:
Dear Straits Meridian Bank Facilities Team,

This is a first-notice update regarding a water leak detected in the ceiling void between Level 23 and Level 22 of Harbourfront One at 08:02 today, 11 October 2026.

What happened: A chilled-water leak was detected by our building management system on Level 23. The water source has been traced to an air-handling unit supply branch and has been isolated at 08:09. The dripping on your Level 22 ceiling has stopped.

What we are doing: Our Technical Services team is on site. The water was detected within proximity of an electrical distribution board, and as a safety precaution we have dispatched a Licensed Electrical Worker to inspect and certify the area before any systems are re-energised. No evacuation is required at this time.

Impact on your floor: Ceiling tiles in the affected area of Level 22 are saturated and will require replacement. Your trading floor (Levels 20-26) cooling is unaffected. We will provide the next update by 08:50.

If you have any questions, please contact our Tenant Experience lead, Ms Lim Hui Fen, at the property management office.

We apologise for the inconvenience and will keep you updated.

Best regards,
Harbourfront One Property Management
